ACCESS: robots.txt for THIS host fetched FIRST (https://shop.vtwonen.nl/robots.txt, 200, 6541 bytes) before any other request to shop.vtwonen.nl. NO group names ClaudeBot, anthropic-ai or Claude-Web - the full file was grepped for 'claude|anthropic': zero hits. Groups present: '*', adsbot-google, Nutch (Disallow: /), AhrefsBot (Crawl-delay: 10), AhrefsSiteAudit, and 'User-Agent: CCBot / Disallow: /' at line 168 followed by a DPG Media copyright notice - CCBot is Common Crawl, not a Claude agent, so it is not a hard stop for this run. The '*' group declares no Crawl-delay and no blanket Disallow; probe.fetch()'s 2s/host pacing was used throughout. Disallows that constrain this run: /search, /collections/*sort_by*, /collections/*+* (and %2B/%2b variants), */collections/*filter*&*filter*, /checkout, /cart, /account, /policies/. I requested NO sort_by, NO multi-filter and NO /search URL - only bare /collections/<handle>, bare '?page=N' pagination (not disallowed) and /collections/<handle>/products.json. Sitemap declared: https://shop.vtwonen.nl/sitemap.xml. All requests HTTP 200 via probe.fetch() (curl_cffi, safari15_5 and rotation).
TREE (three site-owned sources, mutually confirming): (1) The homepage mega-menu, server-rendered as Shopify Liquid with explicit data-level / data-level-index attributes. Panel data-level-index='10' is the 'badkamer' top-level item -> /collections/badkamer-sanitair, containing three level-3 groups: badtextiel (children: badmatten, handdoeken, badjassen), badkamer accessoires (handdoekhouders, zeepdispensers, planchets, toiletrolhouders, toiletborstels) and sanitair (toiletpotten). Each group also carries an 'alle <group>' View-All link back to its own parent - never recorded (rule 25). (2) THE DECISIVE SOURCE - the site's own collection sitemap https://shop.vtwonen.nl/sitemap_collections_1.xml (200, 1600 collections), which is emitted in DEPTH-FIRST HIERARCHICAL ORDER, not alphabetically. The Badkamer & Sanitair branch occupies a single contiguous block, lines 162-252: 162 badkamer-sanitair; 163 badkamer-accessoires + its 16 children (164-179); 180 badkamermeubels + 8 children (181-188); 189 badkamerspiegels + 5 (190-194); 195 badkamer-veiligheid-comfort + 10 (196-205); 206 kranen + 6 (207-212); 213 baden + 3 (214-216); 217 badtextiel + 8 (218-225); 226 douches + 14 (227-240); 241 toiletten + 5 (242-246); 247 wastafels-fonteinen + 5 (248-252). Line 253 starts a different branch (wellness). The mega-menu only surfaces a fraction of this. (3) EVERY hub page was then opened and its OWN on-page child-category tiles (absolute-URL chips, distinct from the repeated global nav) were read back - they reproduce the sitemap block exactly: badkamer-accessoires lists Bad accessoires / Douche accessoires / Handdoekhouders / Make-up organizers / Planchets / Tandenborstelhouders / Tissue houders / Toiletborstels / Toiletrolhouders / Zeepdispensers / Zeephouders; badkamermeubels lists Badkamerrekken / Badmeubels / Badmeubelsets / Kolomkasten / Medicijnkastjes / Spiegelkasten / Toiletmeubels / Wastafelonderkasten; badkamerspiegels, badkamer-veiligheid-comfort, kranen, baden, douches, toiletten and wastafels-fonteinen likewise. So the hierarchy is the site's, not inferred, and no URL was pattern-guessed. Also swept all 1600 sitemap slugs for bathroom vocabulary: radiatoren (line 405), keukenkranen (482), buitendouches (644, outdoor) and strandlakens (1538) sit OUTSIDE the 162-252 block and are not part of this branch (strandlakens is nonetheless a Badtextiel tile and is routed to Textile below).
QTY SOURCE + PROOF: the vtwonen PLP renders NO product total anywhere in the DOM (searched for producten/artikelen/resultaten/aantal/total/count - nothing), and its grid pages at 48 tiles with only a next-page link, so there is no rendered figure to read. Per the brief I therefore used the storefront's OWN product endpoint, Shopify /collections/<handle>/products.json?limit=250&page=N, ENUMERATED TO EXHAUSTION (no reported total is trusted - products were counted). EQUIVALENCE PROVEN against the real PLP on four collections of four different sizes spanning 1, 1, 2 and 7 rendered pages, by paginating shop.vtwonen.nl/collections/<h>?page=N at 48 tiles/page and counting distinct /products/ hrefs: douche-accessoires json=2 / PLP=2; toiletpotten 38 / 38; badmatten 80 / 80; badkamer-accessoires 308 / 308. Exact match in every case. INTERNAL CONSISTENCY - independent corroboration: enumerated child counts reproduce their enumerated parent EXACTLY in eight separate branches, which could not happen if the enumeration were lossy. badkamer-accessoires 308 = 99+2+2+8+1+2+19+16+17+0+35+4+13+35+16+39. badkamermeubels 471 = 53+136+17+63+0+0+49+153. badkamerspiegels 67 = 0+0+0+46+21. kranen 40 = 2+0+0+7+3+28. baden 15 = 0+15+0. douches 179 = 23+35+0+0+0+1+13+0+0+0+10+7+0+90. toiletten 38 = 38+0+0+0+0. wastafels-fonteinen 9 = 5+4+0+0+0. (These identities are stated as EVIDENCE ONLY - no recorded quantity is a sum; every recorded qty is that node's own enumerated count.) Counts plainly discriminate (1 to 1728) and every page's H1 matched the node requested. ZERO-COUNT NODES were re-verified a second way: spiegelkasten, douchegordijnen and wastafels each return 0 by products.json AND 0 by PLP pagination.
DEDUP: already_extracted() run on all 93 candidate URLs in the branch plus /collections/spiegels. Five hits, all moved to review[] and kept out of rows[]: badmeubels -> Furniture.xlsx 'Bathroom Vanity Units'; badmeubelsets -> 'Bathroom Vanity Sets'; kolomkasten -> 'Tall Bathroom Cabinets'; wastafelonderkasten -> 'Washbasin Base Cabinets' (all OPTION 1); spiegels -> Final.xlsx (Home Decor pass) 'Mirrors'. Notably the parent Badkamermeubels and its children Badkamerrekken, Toiletmeubels, Spiegelkasten and Medicijnkastjes are NOT in the index, so the two non-empty ones (Badkamerrekken 17, Toiletmeubels 49) are correctly new Bathroom rows.
ROUTING / EXCLUSIONS: Badtextiel and all nine children -> Textile (rules 15, 16, 20). Douchegordijnen -> Textile (rule 20), though empty. Badkamerspiegelverlichting -> Lighting (rule 11: primary type is the light), while Badkamerspiegels met verlichting (46) stays in Bathroom because there the primary type is the mirror - this is exactly the rule-11 split. Badkamerspiegels zonder verlichting (21) recorded. Sale collection excluded (rule 25). Wellness/sauna branch excluded as a separate top-level node. Roughly 30 nodes across the branch are structurally present but hold 0 products (the whole Badkamer veiligheid & comfort branch, all toilet children except Toiletpotten, all wastafel children except Fonteinen and montageonderdelen, most douche fittings); every one is named explicitly in review[] so nothing is silently skipped, but none is recorded as a row since a node with no products is not a valid listing. NET: 34 recordable Bathroom leaves under 9 grouping rows. No parent URL recorded where children exist, no View All / Shop All / search / PDP URL recorded, no quantity estimated, inherited or summed.
